title: CAMO: Correlation-Aware Mask Optimization with Modulated Reinforcement Learning
problem: Existing machine learning-based optical proximity correction (OPC) approaches are purely data-driven and do not incorporate domain-specific principles of OPC, leading to potential performance and efficiency bottlenecks in ensuring pattern printability during VLSI manufacturing.
motivation: OPC is a critical step in semiconductor manufacturing to ensure accurate transfer of designed circuit patterns to silicon during lithography.
method: CAMO proposes a reinforcement learning-based OPC system that explicitly models spatial correlation among movements of neighboring mask segments and applies OPC-inspired modulation for movement action selection. The system is trained and evaluated on via layer and metal layer patterns.
key_novelty: Integration of OPC-specific domain principles (spatial correlation and modulation) into a reinforcement learning framework, contrasting with generic data-driven approaches.
contributions: RL-based OPC system that explicitly incorporates spatial correlation among neighboring segment movements
OPC-inspired modulation mechanism for action selection in the reinforcement learning framework
Demonstration that domain-aware RL outperforms state-of-the-art academic and industry OPC engines

metrics.other: Outperforms state-of-the-art OPC engines; specific metrics not detailed in abstract

primary_theme: Domain-aware reinforcement learning for semiconductor mask optimization
